title: Radio Tomographic Imaging with Wireless Networks
sections_reviewed: Abstract/introduction; Sections2.1–2.3,4.1–4.2,5.1; delegated read-only primary review
method_summary: Received-power differencing separates fixed Tx/static terms from changing shadowing; a geometry-weighted inverse problem is regularized.
adoption_limits: Inverse problem explicitly ill-posed; coordinated transmissions avoid collisions, so this is not a contention/interference identification experiment.
